_note: Regions are spatial bands in millimetres of the glTF (y up) atlas space; a structure belongs to every region its bounding box intersects. Landmarks: mandible 1421-1506, C7 1365-1392, T12/L1 ~1055, L5 905-955, hip bone 752-958, femur 368-834, fingertips ~653.

regions.name: Head
regions.summary: Skull, brain, eyes, ears, nose, mouth and teeth.

regions.name: Neck
regions.summary: Cervical spine, larynx, pharynx, thyroid region and the great vessels to the head.

regions.name: Thorax
regions.summary: Rib cage, heart, lungs, oesophagus and the great vessels.

regions.name: Abdomen
regions.summary: Stomach, intestines, liver, spleen, pancreas and kidneys.

regions.name: Pelvis
regions.summary: Pelvic bones, bladder, rectum and reproductive organs.

regions.name: Lower limb
regions.summary: Hip, thigh, knee, leg and foot.
